brief: A Steam puzzle game with 83 sudoku variants (killer, thermo, arrow, kropki and more), daily puzzles and 1v1 races. The logo should feel calm and elegant, clever and playful, bold and modern, and work as a 16 px icon.
criteria: Success: a hidden idea players discover (the 9), recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, matches the game's paper/ink/blue look.

concepts.name: Nine Smile
concepts.idea: A face in a sudoku cell: the right eye is a 9, and the 9's tail is the smile.
rationale: The 9 is the hidden idea: the number every sudoku is built on
Friendly at a glance, clever on a second look
Round 9 echoes the DM Serif letters in the name
Reads at 16 px; a hand-drawn pixel cut is used for favicons

recommendation: Use the blue tile as the game icon, the horizontal lockup on the title screen and store page, and the one-colour cell version wherever only one colour is available.
next_steps: Set the blue tile as the Godot project and Windows export icon
Upload the Steam images in Steamworks
